tolerance.basis: rtol = ulp_budget * FP32 unit roundoff; atol anchors near-zero predictions at one tenth of rtol. A deliberate margin against reduction-order drift, not a measured error bound. It bounds forward reproducibility only: loading correctness rests on exact weight identity, which is checked separately.

checkpoint.selected_by: lowest validation loss, restored by EarlyStopping

cas12a.validation_evidence_kind: checkpoint selection only, not independent test
cas12a.new_evaluation_kind: held-out test membership fixed before checkpoint selection

raw.50 bp synthetic target and target contex: Filtering condition: reads above 200, background indels below 8%

limitations: Cas12a training source attestation is retrospective; see preserved provenance.json.

SpCas9 historical evaluation records a dirty source snapshot digest; its full contemporaneous source snapshot is not in the adopted vault. Saved split, labels, predictions and both checkpoint files are retained and replayed here.
No new training, model selection, split change, or NT comparison is performed.
